summary: Edison International filed an 8-K relating to the sale of $500 million principal amount of 5.00% Senior Notes due 2028. The filing is a routine debt offering disclosure under Item 8.01, with no special-situation M&A, activist, restructuring, or other event-driven activity. The notes are sold via underwriters led by Barclays and BofA Securities, issued under a supplemental indenture. No change of control, shareholder vote, or strategic transaction is involved. This is standard financing and does not constitute a special situation.
